questions.prompt: After helper = root.isolate('llm'), a plugin on helper provides llm. Why does it not throw 'already exists'?
options: Below helper, llm maps to a new symbol, so it writes an empty slot
provide never checks for an existing service
The helper has its own copy of the whole store
questions.explanation: The store is keyed by symbols. helper's table gives llm a fresh symbol, so the second adapter fills a different slot from the root's.

questions.prompt: A loop plugin mounted on helper injects llm and tools. Which tools does it get?
options: The root's tools, because only llm was isolated
None: it stays pending until helper provides tools
A fresh copy of the root's tools
The second adapter, because it is the nearest service
questions.explanation: Only llm got a new key below helper. tools still maps to the root's symbol, so the plugin shares the root's tools.

questions.prompt: What does root.get('llm') return after the helper's adapter is mounted?
options: The helper's second adapter, because it was provided last
undefined, because two services now share the name
The flash adapter, because the root's table never changed
An error, because the name is ambiguous
questions.explanation: isolate changes the table of the child only. The root still maps llm to its own symbol, which holds the flash adapter.
